heading: Minimum Public Shareholding

chapter.title: OBLIGATIONS OF 76[A] LISTED ENTITY WHICH HAS LISTED ITS SPECIFIED SECURITIES 77[AND NON-CONVERTIBLE DEBT SECURITIES]

content:
38. The listed entity shall comply with the minimum public shareholding requirements
specified in Rule 19(2) and Rule 19A of the Securities Contracts (Regulation) Rules,
1957 in the manner as specified by the Board from time to time:
Provided that provisions of this regulation shall not apply to entities listed on
406[Innovators Growth Platform] without making a public issue.

footnotes.text:
406 Substituted for “Institutional Trading Platform” by the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure
Requirements) (Second Amendment) Regulations, 2021 w.e.f. 5.5.2021.
